inputs.description: The root folder of a BIDS valid dataset (sub-XXXXX folders should be found at the top level in this folder).
inputs.name: bids_dir

inputs.description: The output path for the outcomes of preprocessing and visual reports
inputs.name: output_dir

inputs.description: Processing stage to be run, only "participant" in the case of fMRIPrep (see BIDS-Apps specification).
inputs.name: analysis_level

inputs.description: Assume the input dataset is BIDS compliant and skip the validation
inputs.name: skip_bids_validation

inputs.description: A space delimited list of participant identifiers or a single identifier (the sub- prefix can be removed)
inputs.name: participant_label

inputs.description: A space delimited list of session identifiers or a single identifier (the ses- prefix can be removed)
inputs.name: session_label

inputs.description: Select a specific task to be processed
inputs.name: task_id

inputs.description: Select a specific echo to be processed in a multiecho series
inputs.name: echo_idx

inputs.description:
Method to produce the reference anatomical space:
	"first-lex" will use the first image in lexicographical order
	"unbiased" will construct an unbiased template from all images (previously "--longitudinal")
	"sessionwise" will independently process each session. If multiple runs are found, the behavior will be similar to "first-lex" for each session. (Default: "first-lex")
inputs.name: subject_anatomical_reference

inputs.description: Track and append session IDs. If disabled, sessions will not be tracked nor appended to FreeSurfer subject ID.
inputs.name: track_sessions

inputs.description: A JSON file describing custom BIDS input filters using PyBIDS. For further details, please check out https://fmriprep.readthedocs.io/en/latest/faq.html#how-do-I-select-only-certain-files-to-be-input-to-fMRIPrep
inputs.name: bids_filter_file

inputs.description: Search PATH(s) for pre-computed derivatives. These may be provided as named folders (e.g., `--derivatives smriprep=/path/to/smriprep`).
inputs.name: derivatives

inputs.description: Path to a PyBIDS database folder, for faster indexing (especially useful for large datasets). Will be created if not present.
inputs.name: bids_database_dir

inputs.description: Maximum number of threads across all processes
inputs.name: nprocs

inputs.description: Maximum number of threads per-process
inputs.name: omp_nthreads

inputs.description: Upper bound memory limit for fMRIPrep processes
inputs.name: mem

inputs.description: Attempt to reduce memory usage (will increase disk usage in working directory)
inputs.name: low_mem

inputs.description: Nipype plugin configuration file
inputs.name: use_plugin

inputs.description: Use low-quality tools for speed - TESTING ONLY
inputs.name: sloppy

inputs.description: Run anatomical workflows only
inputs.name: anat_only

inputs.description: Processing level; may be 'minimal' (nothing that can be recomputed), 'resampling' (recomputable targets that aid in resampling) or 'full' (all target outputs). (Default: "full")
inputs.name: level

inputs.description: Generate boilerplate only
inputs.name: boilerplate_only

inputs.description: Only generate reports, don't run workflows. This will only rerun report aggregation, not reportlet generation for specific nodes.
inputs.name: reports_only

inputs.description: Ignore selected aspects of the input dataset to disable corresponding parts of the workflow (a space delimited list)
inputs.name: ignore

inputs.description:
Force selected processing choices, overriding automatic selections (a space delimited list).
 * [no-]bbr: Use/disable boundary-based registration for BOLD-to-T1w coregistration
             (No goodness-of-fit checks)
 * syn-sdc: Calculate SyN-SDC correction *in addition* to other fieldmaps
inputs.name: force

inputs.description: Standard and non-standard spaces to resample anatomical and functional images to. Standard spaces may be specified by the form ``<SPACE>[:cohort-<label>][:res-<resolution>][...]``, where ``<SPACE>`` is a keyword designating a spatial reference, and may be followed by optional, colon-separated parameters. Non-standard spaces imply specific orientations and sampling grids. Important to note, the ``res-*`` modifier does not define the resolution used for the spatial normalization. To generate no BOLD outputs, use this option without specifying any spatial references. For further details, please check out https://fmriprep.readthedocs.io/en/latest/spaces.html
inputs.name: output_spaces

inputs.description: Deprecated - use `--subject-anatomical-reference unbiased` instead
inputs.name: longitudinal

inputs.description: Method of initial BOLD to anatomical coregistration. If `auto`, a T2w image is used if available, otherwise the T1w image. `t1w` forces use of the T1w, `t2w` forces use of the T2w, and `header` uses the BOLD header information without an initial registration. (Default: "auto")
inputs.name: bold2anat_init

inputs.description: Degrees of freedom when registering BOLD to anatomical images. 6 degrees (rotation and translation) are used by default. (Default: "6")
inputs.name: bold2anat_dof

inputs.description: Deprecated - use `--force bbr` instead.
inputs.name: force_bbr

inputs.description: Deprecated - use `--force no-bbr` instead.
inputs.name: force_no_bbr

inputs.description: The time of the reference slice to correct BOLD values to, as a fraction acquisition time. 0 indicates the start, 0.5 the midpoint, and 1 the end of acquisition. The alias `start` corresponds to 0, and `middle` to 0.5. The default value is 0.5. (Default: 0.5)
inputs.name: slice_time_ref

inputs.description: Number of nonsteady-state volumes. Overrides automatic detection.
inputs.name: dummy_scans

inputs.description: Fallback value for Total Readout Time (TRT) calculation. May be a number or "estimated".
inputs.name: fallback_total_readout_time

inputs.description: Initialize the random seed for the workflow
inputs.name: random_seed

inputs.description: The method by which to estimate T2* and S0 for multi-echo data. 'curvefit' uses nonlinear regression. It is more memory intensive, but also may be more accurate, than 'loglin'. 'loglin' uses log-linear regression. It is faster and less memory intensive, but may be less accurate. (Default: "curvefit")
inputs.name: me_t2s_fit_method

inputs.description: Organization of outputs. "bids" (default) places fMRIPrep derivatives directly in the output directory, and defaults to placing FreeSurfer derivatives in <output-dir>/sourcedata/freesurfer. "legacy" creates derivative datasets as subdirectories of outputs. (Default: "bids")
inputs.name: output_layout

inputs.description: Output individual echo time series with slice, motion and susceptibility correction. Useful for further Tedana processing post-fMRIPrep.
inputs.name: me_output_echos

inputs.description: Maximum number of sessions aggregated in one subject's visual report. If exceeded, visual reports are split by session. (Default: 4)
inputs.name: aggregate_session_reports

inputs.description: Replace medial wall values with NaNs on functional GIFTI files. Only performed for GIFTI files mapped to a freesurfer subject (fsaverage or fsnative).
inputs.name: medial_surface_nan

inputs.description: Exclude voxels whose timeseries have locally high coefficient of variation from surface resampling. Only performed for GIFTI files mapped to a freesurfer subject (fsaverage or fsnative).
inputs.name: project_goodvoxels

inputs.description: Skip generation of HTML and LaTeX formatted citation with pandoc
inputs.name: md_only_boilerplate

inputs.description: Output preprocessed BOLD as a CIFTI dense timeseries. Optionally, the number of grayordinate can be specified (default is 91k, which equates to 2mm resolution) (Default: false)
inputs.name: cifti_output

inputs.description: Enable or disable Multimodal Surface Matching surface registration.
inputs.name: msm

inputs.description: Include all components estimated in CompCor decomposition in the confounds file instead of only the components sufficient to explain 50 percent of BOLD variance in each CompCor mask
inputs.name: return_all_components

inputs.description: Threshold for flagging a frame as an outlier on the basis of framewise displacement (Default: 0.5)
inputs.name: fd_spike_threshold

inputs.description: Threshold for flagging a frame as an outlier on the basis of standardised DVARS (Default: 1.5)
inputs.name: dvars_spike_threshold

inputs.description: Select a template for skull-stripping with antsBrainExtraction (OASIS30ANTs, by default) (Default: "OASIS30ANTs")
inputs.name: skull_strip_template

inputs.description: Do not use a random seed for skull-stripping - will ensure run-to-run replicability when used with --omp-nthreads 1 and matching --random-seed <int>
inputs.name: skull_strip_fixed_seed

inputs.description: Perform T1-weighted skull stripping ('force' ensures skull stripping, 'skip' ignores skull stripping, and 'auto' applies brain extraction based on the outcome of a heuristic to check whether the brain is already masked). (Default: "force")
inputs.name: skull_strip_t1w

inputs.description: Fit a B-Spline field using least-squares (experimental)
inputs.name: fmap_bspline

inputs.description: Do not remove median (within mask) from fieldmap
inputs.name: fmap_no_demean

inputs.description: Use fieldmap-less distortion correction based on anatomical image; if unable, error (default) or warn based on optional argument. (Default: false)
inputs.name: use_syn_sdc

inputs.description: Deprecated - use `--force syn-sdc` instead.
inputs.name: force_syn

inputs.description: Path to FreeSurfer license key file. Get it (for free) by registering at https://surfer.nmr.mgh.harvard.edu/registration.html
inputs.name: fs_license_file

inputs.description: Path to existing FreeSurfer subjects directory to reuse. (default: OUTPUT_DIR/freesurfer)
inputs.name: fs_subjects_dir

inputs.description: Enable or disable sub-millimeter (hi-res) reconstruction.
inputs.name: submm_recon

inputs.description: Disable FreeSurfer surface preprocessing.
inputs.name: fs_no_reconall

inputs.description: EXPERT: Import pre-computed FreeSurfer reconstruction without resuming. The user is responsible for ensuring that all necessary files are present.
inputs.name: fs_no_resume

inputs.description: Tracks power draws using CodeCarbon package
inputs.name: track_carbon

inputs.description: Country ISO code used by carbon trackers (Default: "CAN")
inputs.name: country_code

inputs.description: Increases log verbosity for each occurrence. Debug level is '-vvv'.
inputs.name: verbose

inputs.description: Path where intermediate results should be stored
inputs.name: work_dir

inputs.description: Clears working directory of contents. Use of this flag is not recommended when running concurrent processes of fMRIPrep.
inputs.name: clean_workdir

inputs.description: Enable Nipype's resource monitoring to keep track of memory and CPU usage
inputs.name: resource_monitor

inputs.description: Use pre-generated configuration file. Values in file will be overridden by command-line arguments.
inputs.name: config_file

inputs.description: Write workflow graph.
inputs.name: write_graph

inputs.description: Force stopping on first crash, even if a work directory was specified.
inputs.name: stop_on_first_crash

inputs.description: Opt-out of sending tracking information of this run to the FMRIPREP developers. This information helps to improve FMRIPREP and provides an indicator of real world usage crucial for obtaining funding.
inputs.name: notrack

inputs.description: Debug mode(s) to enable. 'all' is alias for all available modes.
inputs.name: debug
